jobs.title: Director of Operations
jobs.description:
Company Description
Madinat Al Saada Aluminium & Glass Works LLC, founded in 2016, is a fast-growing UAE-based subcontractor specializing in facade works. The company delivers high-quality fabrication and installation services for stick curtain wall systems, skylights, balustrades, handrails, doors, windows, ceilings, aluminium composite panel cladding, and related glass accessories. A highly qualified team focuses on installing durable products and introducing innovative, competitive solutions tailored to client needs. Madinat Al Saada Aluminium & Glass Works LLC is committed to technical excellence, reliable project delivery, and long-term partnerships across the construction and facade industry.
Role Description
The Director of Operations is a full-time, remote role responsible for overseeing day-to-day operational activities across aluminium and glass fabrication and installation projects. This role leads planning, execution, and continuous improvement of processes to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in line with quality and safety standards. Key activities include coordinating cross-functional teams, optimizing resource allocation, managing operational budgets, and monitoring performance metrics. The Director of Operations collaborates closely with project managers, procurement, and senior leadership to streamline workflows, mitigate risks, and support strategic growth. The role also involves maintaining strong relationships with clients and partners, ensuring responsive service and operational alignment with customer expectations.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Operations Management skills, including process optimization, project coordination, and performance monitoring.
Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills for data-driven decision-making, forecasting, and problem-solving.
Candidates should possess effective Team Management abilities, including mentoring, delegation, and cross-functional collaboration.
Candidates should possess sound Budgeting skills, including cost control, resource planning, and financial reporting.
Candidates should possess customer-focused Customer Service capabilities, with the ability to manage client expectations and maintain long-term relationships.
Relevant experience in construction, facade works, or manufacturing operations is highly beneficial.
Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.
Proficiency with project management and ERP tools, and familiarity with quality and safety standards.
Ability to work independently in a remote setting, prioritize multiple projects, and adapt to changing business needs.

jobs.description:
Company Description
VEIC is a nonprofit organization that has supported energy leaders across the United States in achieving clean energy goals for over 40 years. The organization focuses on designing innovative, comprehensive solutions that advance clean energy while strengthening local economies. VEIC’s work is dedicated to improving public health, supporting climate resilience, and building more equitable and sustainable communities. Team members collaborate with public agencies, utilities, and private partners to create measurable, long-term impacts for people and the planet.
Role Description
The Executive Director is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Burlington Area. This position leads the organization’s strategic direction, operational management, and mission delivery, working closely with the Board of Directors and senior leadership to set and execute long-term goals. Day-to-day responsibilities include overseeing program portfolios, ensuring financial sustainability, cultivating key partnerships, and representing VEIC with funders, community leaders, and policy stakeholders. The Executive Director will guide organizational culture, support staff development, and ensure that equity, inclusion, and environmental stewardship are embedded in decision-making and initiatives. The role also involves monitoring performance metrics, managing risk, and adapting strategies to emerging opportunities in the clean energy and nonprofit sectors.
Qualifications

Demonstrated executive leadership experience in nonprofit, public sector, or mission-driven organizations, with a track record of setting strategy and managing complex operations.
Strong financial management skills, including budgeting, revenue development, and stewardship of organizational resources.
Experience in stakeholder engagement and partnership building with community organizations, government agencies, and funders.
Background in clean energy, climate, sustainability, public policy, or a related field, or strong interest and aptitude to quickly gain subject matter knowledge.
Excellent communication, facilitation, and relationship-building skills, including the ability to represent the organization to diverse audiences.
Commitment to equity, inclusion, and community-centered approaches; experience leading teams with inclusive and transparent practices.
Ability to lead organizational change, support staff growth, and foster a collaborative, mission-driven work environment.
Relevant advanced degree (e.g., public administration, business, environmental studies, or related discipline) or equivalent combination of education and leadership experience.

Cristadoro Insights is a growing organization that combines data-informed decision making with innovative program design in sports and youth development. The company is committed to creating engaging, safe, and skill-building experiences for children and teens through structured activity programs. Team members collaborate closely to design and deliver programs that foster confidence, discipline, and physical literacy. The NinjaZone and Parkour Program Director is a full-time, on-site role based in Telluride, CO. This role oversees the planning, development, and daily operation of NinjaZone and parkour classes and events, ensuring programs are safe, engaging, and aligned with organizational standards. Ability to work on-site in Telluride, CO and meet the physical demands of demonstrating movement skills, setting up equipment, and actively supervising activities.
CPR/First Aid certification or willingness to obtain it; familiarity with risk management and safety protocols in athletic or recreational settings.

jobs.description:
Summary Of Job Description

The Executive Director, Strategic Sourcing (Protein) is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the development of strategies and the strategic optimal arrangements related to the sourcing of various product/service categories for the company through collaboration with the other departments. This position’s portfolio of products is high in dollars expenditure (approximately $900 million+ in sourcing span management) and in its level of impact on the company’s financial performance and reputation. The Executive Director executes and oversees the selection, evaluation, and negotiation for PRG purchases in various categories, ensuring that the suppliers selected fit Panda’s culture and philosophy, have the necessary capacity, provide the items at the best price and highest quality.

Job Responsibilities

Oversees and optimizes the development and execution of sourcing strategy using the 10-step strategic sourcing process for assigned products and categories in support of its business strategy and plan. Identifies suppliers and arranges optimal contracts in terms of pricing, quality, timing, and supply availability over the term of the contract. Interacts with the highest level of executives at supplier companies. Advises senior leadership on the availability of specific products and pricing, pre-qualifying new suppliers and facilities in terms of price, capacity, safety and quality. Ensures costs are within budget.
Oversees and provides coaching and leadership in commodities markets on prices and supply and oversees the strategy and direction for optimal procurement and logistics program.
Responsible for achieving strategic optimal arrangements related to sourcing various product/service categories for the company through collaboration with the related departments. Executes the company’s sourcing arrangements in support of its business strategy and plan. Identifies suppliers and arranges optimal contracts in terms of pricing, quality, timing, and supply availability over the term of the contract. Interacts with the highest level of executives at supplier companies. Advises senior leadership on the availability of specific products and pricing, pre-qualifying new suppliers and facilities in terms of price, capacity, and quality. Ensures costs are within budget.
Supports SVP and VP of Supply Chain to develop and execute the three- to five-year sourcing strategic plans and strategic supplier partnerships, anticipating business requirements. The plan includes identifying supplier sources, their purchasing capacity, and any legal/tariff issues. Informs the VP and senior leadership on industry insights, such as tariffs, import/export limitations, government regulations, Act of God situations, mergers, acquisitions, personnel changes, new item introduction, etc.
Recruits, selects, and develops an effective team of purchasing management, professional, and support staff. Provides leadership, coaching and development to the team to meet the department’s people planning and development goals.
Identifies new suppliers to support future growth. Attends supplier and industry shows to identify potential suppliers, domestic and international. Evaluates potential suppliers in collaboration with other PRG departments concerning the viability of their product and acceptability of their manufacturing facility. Negotiates optimal pricing with new suppliers.
Maintains a strong relationship between suppliers and the company. Communicates with suppliers concerning PRG philosophy and growth plans and aligns suppliers with Panda to support growth. Evaluates the effectiveness of suppliers to identify which ones to expand the relationship.
Ensures sourcing alignment with cross-functional business objectives. Leads or supports cross-functional projects with departments such as FSQA, Product Development, Marketing, Legal, Finance, RD, and Operations related to product specifications, quality inquiries, product recall, sourcing new ingredients, testing new products, and phasing in products within distribution.
